successors.name: Spanish Empire
successors.text: 'As a result of the alliance with the Spaniards, Tlaxcala had hidalgo privileged status within New Spain'

ledger.x: 1348: the Tlaxcalans settle their valley and found Tepeticpac Texcallan.
1521: Tlaxcala, Cortes's ally since 23 September 1519, passes into New Spain with privileges.

wars.name: Flower wars
wars.outcome: Intermittent ritual wars between the Triple Alliance and the cities of the Tlaxcala-Puebla valley; Tlaxcala was never conquered.

wars.name: Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire (Tlaxcalan alliance)
wars.outcome: Tlaxcala fought the Spaniards in three battles on 2-5 September 1519 and allied with Cortes on 23 September 1519; its warriors took part in the siege of Tenochtitlan (10 May to 13 August 1521).

certainty.note: No boundary is described; the enclave is the modern state by my reading.

sources.title: Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire
